motivation: First-order symbolic pattern induction for Advice Taker, Prolog knowledge bases, proof-rule induction and program ASTs. Reused also for grammatical (Panini) structures, astronomical observation event models and SDR/FPGA event descriptions; no application-specific hardware primitive.

donor.name: SWI-Prolog term_subsumer/3
donor.historical_context: Plotkin/Reynolds anti-unification least general generalization of first-order terms; bounded implementation borrows observable finite-term semantics, not cyclic term or attributed-variable SWI extensions.
donor.donor_parity: Finite acyclic ground Prolog terms only; do not assert exact identity for cyclic graphs, constraint-attributed variables, order of internal fresh variable identifiers or side effects.

rows.argument_shape: (ground_acyclic_first_order_term A, ground_acyclic_first_order_term B) -> (LGG G, substitutions sigma_A, sigma_B)
rows.law: Return a least-general generalization G and witness substitutions, i.e. G[sigma_A]=A and G[sigma_B]=B. Preserve identical atoms and identical same-arity functors recursively. Distinct pairs of disagreeing subterms become fresh variables, but the SAME ordered pair recurring at different positions MUST reuse the SAME variable; thus G preserves sharing/equality constraints. Variable identifiers are normalized to first left-to-right occurrence.
preconditions: Terms are finite, ground and acyclic; represent constants and named functors with bounded finite argument sequences.
Functor identity includes symbol and exact arity; equality is structural, not source-surface text, pointer identity or host evaluation.
Fresh variables in the result are pattern metavariables, not executable D2 binders or SENS source variable definitions.

witnesses.reason: Repeated ordered mismatch pair (a,b) must re-use one metavariable; pair(V0,V1) is less specific.
Distinct disagreement pairs (a,b),(a,c) must remain independent.
Keep exact shared relation and subject.
Reused pair beneath matching inner functors.
Different outer functors cannot share a root.
Astronomy pattern induction retains predicate and state.

falsifiers: Returning the constant 'a' as LGG(a,b) fails to instantiate to b.
Returning pair(V0,V1) for pair(a,a) vs pair(b,b) is unnecessarily general; shared disagreement variable must be reused.
Returning pair(V0,V0) for pair(a,a) vs pair(b,c) fails to instantiate to both terms under one substitution.
Treating functors f/1 and f/2 as identical when arity differs is invalid.
Binding actual D2 program variables or mutating source terms is not part of this pure mathematical contract.
Claiming support for cyclic Prolog terms or term attributes from ground finite witnesses is not warranted.
rows.dedup: Exact-name absent in main 634. Unlike UNIFY, anti-unify seeks G so both terms are instances of G, rather than substitutions making inputs equal. Important owner question: expressible by recursive folds; proof of an independent Core-D10 root vs self-hosted library still pending.
rows.owner_question: Should the unique, pair-sharing preserving least-general-generalization law be language-visible D10 research, or should it be a first-class library semantic composed from finite term recursion and map? No numerical coordinate until a separate owner decision.
